exercises.name: Hello World
exercises.instructions:
Implement hello_world(). It must return exactly Hello World! followed by a newline. The goal is to confirm that your editor, Run flow, and official Submit flow are working.

Function signature:

def hello_world():
    ...

Expected result:
Hello World!\n

exercises.name: IsPositive
exercises.instructions:
Implement is_positive(n). Return P when n is positive or zero. Return N when n is negative.

The important edge case is 0: it must return P.

exercises.name: StrLen
exercises.instructions:
Implement str_len(value). Count and return the number of characters in value.

Restriction: do not use Python's built-in len() function.

restrictions.message: Do not use len(). Count the characters yourself.

exercises.name: ReverseString
exercises.instructions:
Implement reverse_string(value). Return value reversed.

It must handle an empty string and a single-character string without crashing.

Restriction: do not use slicing shorthand like [::-1].

restrictions.message: Do not use [::-1]. Reverse the string manually.
